title: Foundations: describing skin
blurb: Start here: the language of dermatology (primary and secondary lesions, configuration, distribution), skin layers, Fitzpatrick skin types and why dermoscopy helps.

title: Inflammatory skin
blurb: Eczema, psoriasis, contact dermatitis and urticaria, plus the inflammatory spot diagnoses: erythema multiforme, annular rashes, lichen planus and discoid lupus.

title: Blistering diseases
blurb: How to approach blisters, then pemphigus, bullous pemphigoid, dermatitis herpetiformis and drug-induced blistering including SJS/TEN, with same-day referral routes.

title: Hands, feet & skin folds
blurb: Hidradenitis suppurativa and intertrigo in the folds; hand eczema, pompholyx, keratolysis exfoliativa and palmoplantar pustulosis on the palms and soles.

title: Nails
blurb: Paronychia and ingrowing toenail, fungal nail infection, melanonychia and nail melanoma, and the nail signs of skin and systemic disease.

title: Acne & follicles
blurb: Disorders of the pilosebaceous unit, with NICE NG198 treatment ladders, antibiotic stewardship and the acne mimics.

title: Infections — fungal
blurb: Dermatophyte and yeast infections: tinea of the body, groin and feet, pityriasis versicolor and candidal intertrigo.

title: Infections — bacterial
blurb: Superficial to deep bacterial skin infections: impetigo (including MRSA), cellulitis and erysipelas, folliculitis, boils and carbuncles, scarlet fever and cutaneous tuberculosis.

title: Infections — viral & infestations
blurb: Viral warts, shingles, cold sores and pityriasis rosea, plus scabies, head lice, Lyme disease, bite reactions and perineal dermatoses.

title: Tropical & travel
blurb: The returning traveller with a skin problem: cutaneous leishmaniasis, larva migrans, dengue, leprosy and mycetoma.

title: Ulcers & red leg
blurb: Venous, arterial and neuropathic ulcers, pyoderma gangrenosum, and the red-leg differential, so you don’t treat every red leg as cellulitis.

title: Photodermatoses
blurb: Rashes driven by light: polymorphic light eruption, chronic actinic dermatitis, drug-induced photosensitivity and porphyria cutanea tarda, with a sun-protection script.

title: Pigment & colour change
blurb: Hypo- and hyperpigmentation. Progressive macular hypomelanosis in full, plus melasma, lichenoid pigmentation and vitiligo (Module 6 Week 3).

title: Childhood & neonatal
blurb: Module 6 Week 1: neonatal pustular rashes, infant acne, nappy rash, vascular and pigmented birthmarks, epidermolysis bullosa and aplasia cutis.

title: Ageing skin & older adults
blurb: Itch and xerosis, skin fragility and dermatoporosis, actinic keratoses and photoageing in older adults.

title: Hair & scalp
blurb: Pattern hair loss (incl. PRP), alopecia areata, telogen effluvium, trichotillomania and scarring alopecia: name the pattern and spot scarring early.

title: Cosmetic & aesthetic
blurb: Acne scars and keloids, peels, needling and lasers, and counselling-level aesthetic topics (neuromodulators, solar lentigines, IPL).

title: Therapeutics
blurb: Prescribing tools: topical steroids and fingertip units, emollients, vitamin D analogues, tar and phototherapy, retinoids, acne pills, hirsutism and the biologics interface.

title: Drug eruptions
blurb: When a medicine causes the rash: morbilliform eruptions, DRESS and AGEP, ACE-inhibitor angioedema, erythema nodosum, pigmentation, fixed drug eruption and how to report.

title: Vasculitis & purpura
blurb: Palpable purpura, urticarial vasculitis, polyarteritis nodosa, livedo, IgA vasculitis, endocarditis signs and the purpura differential, with the same-day checks.

title: Skin signs of systemic disease
blurb: When the skin points inside: dermatomyositis, lung cancer signs, Cushing’s, hyperhidrosis, Addison’s, eruptive xanthomas, acanthosis nigricans, sarcoidosis, and the worked cases (including pyoderma gangrenosum).

title: Lumps, lesions & skin cancer
blurb: Benign lumps and lesions, BCC, SCC and cutaneous lymphoma, moles and naevi, melanoma recognition, staging and treatment, NICE NG12 referral routes and teledermatology.

title: Skin surgery
blurb: Minor skin surgery at knowledge level: pre-operative checks, anticoagulants, local anaesthetic doses, allergy, consent and complications, procedures and aftercare.

title: Exam review
blurb: End-of-module exam reviews for Modules 2, 4 and 5: answer, reasoning, why the distractors are wrong, and links to the matching condition pages.
